description: This file defines a ValidatorActionFilter class implementing IActionFilter for ASP.NET Core, used for validating model state in API requests and returning error details as JSON when validation fails.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A filter for validating model state in ASP.NET Core MVC actions and returning JSON error responses.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the model state is valid; if not, constructs a JSON response with errors and sets the HTTP status to 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: An empty implementation of the IActionFilter interface method, called after action executes.
